spec.scene: On a sunlit wooden pier plank floor, two small figures in yellow and teal jackets sit at a round picnic table in the center, sharing two steaming sourdough bread bowls. Leaned against the rustic timber railing on the right stand two turquoise beach cruiser bikes. Over the railing along the back edge, two glossy brown sea lions rest on exposed wooden dock pilings, mouths open in mid-bark. Golden coastal sunlight washes the warm weathered wood and creates bright highlights on the warm soup.
spec.title: Chowder on the Wharf
spec.caption: Maya and I biked the cliffs and watched sea lions yell.
